author: Codex
request: Compare R1 and F3c on identical trunk/preprocessing, preserve both, publish findings locally, no new submission without evidence.
prior_knowledge: R1 public .15820 vs F3c .16914 known. Earlier diagnostic showed substantial six-cell level differences. No hidden target/segment scores inferred.2024 is adaptive development.
hypothesis: The delivery gap confounds own-NB policy with source/preprocessing, F2/nuisance, learned renewal effects and public shape/level overlays. Matched policy applications and an exact price bridge can locate price changes, not score loss.

design.matched_F3c_trunk: Hold final_creible C1 baseline and ALL preprocessing fixed. PublishedF3c versus NB=C1, renewal=publishedF3c. No later normalization, factor or level; preserve exact baseline.
design.matched_R1_trunk: Hold R1 frozen T2b baseline, F2/shape, target2023-24 parameters and cell normalizers fixed. PublishedR1 policy versus full own block with those SAME parameters. No re-estimation.
design.control: Both matched pairs must be identical on renewal; F3c-NB andR1-NB fallback equal their own base. Buildings own-block identity within CSV-rounding tolerance. NB data missing from own fields does not alter NB fallback.
design.decomposition: Four fixed positive price multipliers: NB own-policy removal on F3c, own-block relearning only in renewal, removal of C1/F2 historical public shape/level, remaining R1baseline/F2. Exact multiplicative bridge, and order-invariant 4factor Shapley CU decomposition. Not causal D2 attribution.
design.historical_evidence: Reuse existing protected T2b primary and A1/mix sensitivity policy intervals/scenario receipts exactly; no repeat bootstrap/fit/scoring. They compare policies within each matched family, not exact legacy3seedF1/public F3c.
design.strata: Six ramo/business cells; exposure fixed bins <.5,.5-.9,>=.9. No data-driven bins or weight search.
design.limits: Ratios F3c/C1 derive from published output artifacts; do not claim recovery of fitted factors or clean training. C1/F2 are historical public-calibration changes, not evidence to adopt public multipliers on T2b.

acceptance: Diagnostic only: all provenance, price identities, independent permutation-average Shapley, full-file and fallback controls pass. No candidate promotion/admission or private-superiority statement from aggregate prices. Failure preserved, no rescue by new factors.

budget.shadow_price_files: private Parquet only, no upload CSV

future_decision: Prioritize matched protected history and target-level/ultimate transport before further source/feature complexity; any later experiment needs its own criterion and scope. Preserve failed versions and concurrent authorship.
